recognize_zh: 低中倍切片：組織被形態一致、瀰漫片狀生長的小至中型圓核細胞完全取代，無正常結構；中央有一團核較深染的細胞聚集在血管周圍，符合淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤的瀰漫浸潤。
features: Diffuse effacement by sheets of monotonous small- to intermediate-sized round cells
High N:C ratio with round nuclei and fine chromatin
Central perivascular aggregate of more hyperchromatic cells
Scattered red cells and delicate vessels; no follicles or residual normal architecture
describe_en: Low- to intermediate-power H&E section shows diffuse effacement of tissue architecture by sheets of monotonous small- to intermediate-sized round cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and fine chromatin. A central aggregate of more hyperchromatic cells surrounds a small vessel. No residual follicles or normal structures are identified. Findings are consistent with a diffuse high-grade lymphoid neoplasm, compatible with lymphoblastic lymphoma; cytologic detail at higher power and TdT immunostaining are needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger (>2x lymphocyte size) with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, and are TdT negative.
SLL cells have coarse clumped chromatin and show proliferation centers rather than fine blastic chromatin.

ddx.dx: Ewing sarcoma/small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Ewing sarcoma is CD45 negative and CD99/NKX2-2 positive with EWSR1 rearrangement, whereas lymphoblasts are CD45 and TdT positive.
